info.name: PriNotes
info.summary: Rich, private note-taking with offline Android sync
info.description:
PriNotes is a feature-rich, privacy-first note-taking application for Nextcloud that keeps your data on your own server.
## Features
**Web Editor** - Rich block editor: headings, paragraphs, lists, checklists, code blocks, quotes, dividers - Full-canvas freehand drawing support - Image attachments with resize and rotate - Per-note color coding - Pin important notes to the top
**Organisation** - Notebooks — group notes into colour-coded collections - Tags — cross-notebook labels with colour support - Archive and Trash with restore and permanent delete - Full-text search across all notes
**Security & Privacy** - Per-note PIN lock — content never exposed in search or previews when locked - App-wide PIN + biometric lock (Android) - Hidden notes vault — reveal a secret set of notes only with a private vault password - All data stays on your Nextcloud server — nothing leaves your infrastructure
**Android App** - Native offline-first Android client with automatic background sync - Grid and list view with live preview - Works fully offline; syncs when connectivity is restored - Persistent view preferences
## Android App Installation
Download the latest APK from the [Releases page](https://github.com/UrbanTechIO/nextcloud-prinotes/releases) and sideload it:
1. On your Android device go to **Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps** 2. Allow your browser or file manager to install APKs 3. Open the downloaded `.apk` file and tap **Install**
